name: Norway
famous_for: Geirangerfjord & Nærøyfjord dramatic sea fjords, Midnight Sun, Lofoten Islands fishing cabins, and Viking maritime history.
tourists: Over 5.9M international tourists annually; famous for Trolltunga cliff ledge, Preikestolen, Flåm Railway, and Tromsø aurora tours.
must_know: 'Allemannsretten' (Right to Roam) is a foundational law granting everyone freedom to hike and camp responsibly anywhere in nature.
fun_fact: Norway has the second-longest coastline in the world (over 100,000 km including fjords and islands) and introduced salmon sushi to Japan.
